maddeler.e:
انفصلت (form VII)
# اِنْفَصَلْتُ (infaṣaltu) /in.fa.sˤal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# اِنْفَصَلْتَ (infaṣalta) /in.fa.sˤal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# اِنْفَصَلْتِ (infaṣalti) /in.fa.sˤal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# اِنْفَصَلَتْ (infaṣalat) /in.fa.sˤa.lat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
